name: sticky-pad
description: Turn finished project plans into Markdown notes and optionally queue them in a safe Hermes Inbox.

interface.shortDescription: Send finished plans to native desktop notes.
interface.longDescription: Fills a project-loop template, saves and opens the completed Markdown through Sticky Pad, and can optionally queue an existing note as blocked and unassigned in an isolated Hermes Inbox.
defaultPrompt: Send this finished project plan to Sticky Pad.
Turn our plan into a desktop sticky note.
Queue this Sticky Pad task for Hermes without interrupting Commander.
